Creation is an act performed once and for all but various specimens are being manifested in time.

The speech of God is composed of letters and sounds and God creates it in somebody.

Man is responsible for good and evil. 5.

Ash'arism is the name of a theological school of thought in Islam that surfaced during the 4th - 5th/10th - 11th centuries.

The Islamic theology is the science which studies religious doctrines and provides logical proofs in defense of faith.
